title: Blockwise decomposition of a paired scan
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $G_0,G_1$ be local update rules on optional encoded cells, and let $u,u'$ be Boolean words. If both words have length $W_Nm$ for some natural number $m$, then scanning the paired words one bit at a time and applying the two update rules produces the same pair of scan states as pairing their decoded length-$W_N$ blocks and folding the respective local update rules over those block pairs, starting from the initial scan state.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$G_0,G_1$ are local update rules on optional encoded cells
There is a natural number $m$ with $|u|=W_Nm$
There is a natural number $m$ with $|u'|=W_Nm$
